parameters.title: The heading displayed above the content.
parameters.subtitle: Secondary information displayed with the main content.
parameters.label: The visible or accessible name of this part.
parameters.note: Supporting text shown with the main content.
parameters.leading: Places a widget before the main label.
parameters.trailing: A figure or a RetroDesktopFlag beside the title, held to a share of the row.
parameters.figure: The main figure displayed by this part.
parameters.action: Places a short secondary action beside the row.
parameters.isFirst: Applies the treatment for the first row in a group.
parameters.selected: Whether the part represents the current selection.
parameters.enabled: Controls whether the row accepts input.
parameters.style: Overrides the component’s themed appearance for this instance.
parameters.focusNode: Supplies a focus node owned and disposed by the caller.
parameters.autofocus: Requests focus when the control first appears.

keyboardNote: Retro Desktop takes the title as the row’s default accessible name. This example includes the changing status in label.
